caption:
Jignesh from the NYC community built Idiot Box, a free, open-source desktop IDE. The code editor, terminal, browser, a visual project map, a test explorer and a debugger all sit in one window. It's built with Electron and React, and it's on the Microsoft Store.

Windows (Microsoft Store): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PB1J8PS17ZT
macOS and Linux downloads: https://thewonderlandstudio.github.io/Idiot_Box/download.html
Code: https://github.com/TheWonderlandStudio/Idiot_Box

Save this for the day your open windows outnumber your ideas. Send it to the friend who runs one file across three apps.
